meta.sources_note: Expansion batch 11 (DECISIONS 033, continuous expansion per DECISIONS 027, no per-batch approval): 5 new models, 12 quotes. Meta Catalog CLI run 2026-11-06 (20 rows per model; raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_{apple-magic-trackpad-usbc,sony-wh-ch720n,logitech-g915-x,xbox-adaptive-controller,keychron-k8}_2026-11-06.json, gitignored). Brand-direct / retailer prices verified read-only 2026-11-06 ~18:33-18:40 UTC (10:33-10:40 PT): no sign-in, no cart, no purchase. CORRECTIONS vs the 2026-10-31 candidate notes: (1) The Magic Trackpad candidate price $129 is the White price (MXK93AM/A, Apple direct $129.00 InStock, UPC 195949654305); the Black trackpad (MXKA3AM/A) is $149 at Apple direct/Staples/P.C. Richard ($149.99 at Best Buy) and is a different colorway. (2) The WH-CH720N candidate price $89.99 is the current Sony direct sale price (was $179.99), not a stale figure — the launch MSRP was $149.99 (Sony press release 2023-02-21) while Sony's own page now lists MSRP $179.99; retailer street price is $178-$180 (B&H $178.00 InStock, BJ's $179.99, P.C. Richard $179.95). (3) The G915 X candidate price $129.99 was an Amazon Clicky-switch deal price (Grail Alerts 2026-11-01; pricehistory.app Clicky 920-012704 at $129.99), not the standard US Tactile price — the LIGHTSPEED full-size Tactile Black (920-012670) is $259.99 at Logitech G, Best Buy and Quill (B&H $219.99 sale). The logitechg.com page defaults to the full-size LIGHTSPEED line at $259.99 with per-switch URLs (.920-012670 Tactile, .920-012696 Linear, .920-012704 Clicky). (4) The Xbox Adaptive Controller candidate price $99.99 is confirmed current at Microsoft Store and Best Buy; the current retail MPN is JMU-00003 (Best Buy SKU 6455394, InStock) — the older JMU-00001 Best Buy listing (SKU 6381218) is no longer available in new condition. (5) The Keychron K8 candidate price $59.99+ is the base price (K8-A1, soldered Gateron G Pro Red, $59.99); the pinned hot-swappable Red K8-G1 is $69.99. Two direct prices are price-only (stock not confirmed in the page text): Microsoft direct Adaptive Controller $99.99 and Keychron direct K8-G1 $69.99 (K8-G1 out of stock in the 2026-11-06 product JSON read, was Available 2 days earlier; Blue/Brown hot-swappable siblings in stock). Excluded as captured: marketplace/third-party rows (DECISIONS 021) — FlexShopper Adaptive $123.99 (marketplace), Newegg K8 rows ($127.99 Version 2 QMK, $126.55 White Backlight — third-party/unclear variant), Newegg CH720N rows (seller/variant ambiguous), Woot K8 $39.99 (deal/clearance, variant ambiguous, 90-day warranty); non-US rows — Trackpad icon.co.cr $174.99/$184.99, 961souq $230, soytechno $268, CH720N iCuracao $179.99, G915 X Ayoub $143, fnac $173.16, K8 Desertcart is a spec source only (not a quote); bundles — CH720N + 26-month extended warranty $129.99, BuyDig E993 CH720N $129.99 (kit SKU), G915 X + accessory combos; different variants — Trackpad Black MXKA3AM/A ($149/$149.99), CH720N Blue WHCH720N/L ($179.99/$195.99), G915 X Clicky 920-012704 / Linear 920-012696 (both $259.99), G915 X TKL Tactile 920-012726 ($229.99), G915 X wired Linear 920-012950 ($199.99 / $169.99 at Staples), Adaptive Joystick $29.99, Adaptive Dual Button $59.99, K8 Max / K8 Pro / K8 HE rows, K8 RGB hot-swappable Red K8-H1 ($79.99) and aluminum-frame K8 variants ($79.99-$89.99); above-list rows — CDW Adaptive $128.99, BuyDig Adaptive $124.99, DataVision CH720N $130 (condition not asserted), GearOne CH720N $201.56, shopcgx CH720N $69.99 (below cost, suspicious), pens.com CH720N $981.05 (garbage); the feed's Best Buy G915 X $259.99 Tactile row is the White variant (SKU 6595195, 920-012685) and was not used for the Black price — the Black Best Buy price comes from the page-verified Black listing (Model 920-012670, SKU 6595193).
